scripts.build:staging: npm run catalog:export && tsc -b && vite build --base=/ --mode staging
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply codechronicle-staging --local --config wrangler.staging.jsonc && wrangler d1 execute codechronicle-staging --local --file seed.game.sql --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.dev:staging: npm run build:staging && npm run db:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
